$:set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='.devcontainer/devcontainer.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
d['postAttachCommand']='gh codespace ports visibility 3000:public -c "$CODESPACE_NAME"'
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
f=.devcontainer/devcontainer.json
sha=$(gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" --jq .sha)
gh api -X PUT "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" -f message="Restore public Codespace MCP port per owner instruction" -f sha="$sha" -f content="$(base64 -w0 "$f")" --jq '.commit.sha'
gh codespace list --json name,state --limit 100 || true
